Weeks after the Democratic establishment joined Abdul El-Sayed's opponents in
[attacking](https://zeteo.com/p/abdul-el-sayed-hasan-piker-michigan-senate-
media) him for appearing alongside the progressive streamer [Hasan Piker
](https://zeteo.com/p/hasan-piker-heart-and-mind)at a campaign rally, El-Sayed
is surging in the U.S. Senate primary. Polling by [Mitchell Research &
Communications](https://t.co/bTIhe7Objb) shows El-Sayed in first place, at
28%, with Haley Stevens trailing at 18%, and Mallory McMorrow one point
further back.

Last November, the same firm showed Stevens leading with 27%, McMorrow at 24%,
and El-Sayed at 16%. El-Sayed has since surged while the other two have
fallen.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Much has happened between the two polls, but among the most high-profile
episodes was when [Piker rallied with El-Sayed](https://zeteo.com/p/abdul-el-
sayed-hasan-piker-michigan-senate-media). In the lead-up to the event, right-
wing, centrist, and pro-Israel groups assailed the link-up. Stevens attacked
El-Sayed too, while Senator Elissa Slotkin accused him of campaigning with
someone "**who has a history of antisemitic rhetoric**." McMorrow also got
into the fray, comparing Piker to antisemitic far-right white nationalist Nick
Fuentes.

[Speaking to ](https://zeteo.com/p/hasan-piker-heart-and-
mind)**[Zeteo](https://zeteo.com/p/hasan-piker-heart-and-mind)**[ last
month](https://zeteo.com/p/hasan-piker-heart-and-mind), Piker, who rightly
rejects accusations of antisemitism while maintaining a critical stance on
Israel, called the Fuentes comparison "**totally indecent** ," objecting to
"**being compared to an avowed neo-Nazi white supremacist, whose worldview I
find to be morally repugnant, whose opinions I have spent my entire life
combating - opinions just like that.**"

It is safe to say that most Michigan Democratic voters are rejecting such
smears - and El-Sayed is surging. The new poll shows him winning voters
between the ages of 18 and 44 with genuinely
_[astonishing](https://x.com/prem_thakker/status/2054211373459018211?s=20)_
